title: Boss: a cookie-session app
summary: Build a complete cookie-based login: rotation, CSRF on every change, per-user data and real logout.

steps.title: The brief
body: You are shipping a small notes app that authenticates with cookies. The security review checklist from this module:
- session ids: random, at least 256 bits, rotated at login, never adopted from the client
- every state-changing request: authenticated (`401`) **and** carrying the CSRF token (`403`)
- logout: deletes the server-side session; "log out everywhere" deletes all of the user's sessions
- users only ever see their own data

steps.title: Session rotation in the store
prompt: Extend the idea of the session store with rotation and mass revocation. Write a class `SessionManager`:
- `string Create(string user)`: new 64-hex-character id.
- `string? GetUser(string id)`
- `string? Rotate(string oldId)`: if `oldId` is a live session, remove it and return a **new** id for the same user; otherwise `null`. (Call this when a user steps up to MFA or changes role.)
- `int RemoveAll(string user)`: delete every session of that user, return how many were removed.
`System.Security.Cryptography` is already imported by the tests.
solution: public string? GetUser(string id) => _sessions.TryGetValue(id, out var u) ? u : null;
if (!_sessions.Remove(oldId, out var user)) return null;
hints: `Dictionary.Remove(key, out var value)` removes and hands back the value in one call.
`RemoveAll`: collect the matching keys into a list first, then remove them (you can't change a dictionary while enumerating it).
template: using System.Security.Cryptography;
var dojoM = new SessionManager();
var dojoA1 = dojoM.Create("ada");
var dojoA2 = dojoM.Create("ada");
var dojoG = dojoM.Create("grace");
Dojo.Eq("ids are 64 characters", 64, dojoA1.Length);
Dojo.Eq("GetUser finds ada", "ada", dojoM.GetUser(dojoA1));
var dojoR = dojoM.Rotate(dojoA1);
Dojo.Check("Rotate returns a different id", dojoR is not null && dojoR != dojoA1, dojoR ?? "null");
Dojo.Eq("the old id is gone", null, dojoM.GetUser(dojoA1));
Dojo.Eq("the new id belongs to ada", "ada", dojoM.GetUser(dojoR!));
Dojo.Eq("rotating an unknown id gives null", null, dojoM.Rotate("nope"));
Dojo.Eq("rotating a retired id gives null", null, dojoM.Rotate(dojoA1));
Dojo.Eq("RemoveAll(ada) removes 2 sessions", 2, dojoM.RemoveAll("ada"));
Dojo.Eq("ada's sessions are gone", null, dojoM.GetUser(dojoA2));
Dojo.Eq("grace is untouched", "grace", dojoM.GetUser(dojoG));
Dojo.Eq("RemoveAll for nobody removes 0", 0, dojoM.RemoveAll("nobody"));
{{CODE}}

steps.title: The gatekeeper
prompt: Before building the app, write the single function every state-changing request will pass through:
```csharp
int Gate(string method, string? origin, string? sentToken, string? sessionToken, string ownOrigin)
Return the HTTP status the request deserves:
- `GET`, `HEAD` and `OPTIONS` are safe methods: return `200` whatever else is true (they must not change state anyway).
- otherwise, `sessionToken == null` means there is no session: `401`.
- an `origin` that is present and not equal to `ownOrigin` (ignoring case): `403`.
- `sentToken` missing, or not equal to `sessionToken` (constant-time, on UTF-8 bytes): `403`.
- otherwise `200`.
starter: int Gate(string method, string? origin, string? sentToken, string? sessionToken, string ownOrigin)
solution: int Gate(string method, string? origin, string? sentToken, string? sessionToken, string ownOrigin)
if (origin is not null && !string.Equals(origin, ownOrigin, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return 403;
hints: Handle the safe methods first with `method is "GET" or "HEAD" or "OPTIONS"`.
Then 401, then the Origin check, then the token check.
template: {{CODE}}
const string Own = "https://notes.example";
Dojo.Eq("GET with nothing -> 200", 200, Gate("GET", "https://evil.example", null, null, Own));
Dojo.Eq("POST without a session -> 401", 401, Gate("POST", Own, "t", null, Own));
Dojo.Eq("POST from another origin -> 403", 403, Gate("POST", "https://evil.example", "t", "t", Own));
Dojo.Eq("POST without a token -> 403", 403, Gate("POST", Own, null, "t", Own));
Dojo.Eq("POST with the wrong token -> 403", 403, Gate("DELETE", Own, "u", "t", Own));
Dojo.Eq("POST with the right token -> 200", 200, Gate("POST", Own, "t0k3n", "t0k3n", Own));
Dojo.Eq("no Origin header but the right token -> 200", 200, Gate("PUT", null, "t0k3n", "t0k3n", Own));
Dojo.Eq("Origin compared ignoring case -> 200", 200, Gate("POST", "HTTPS://NOTES.EXAMPLE", "t", "t", Own));

steps.title: The notes app
prompt: Build the whole app on top of the starter (users ada / `correct horse` and grace / `hopper-1906`, `CheckPassword`, a `Session(User, CsrfToken)` record). **Run checks** starts the server and calls it.
| Endpoint | Behaviour |

| `POST /login` `{username, password}` | `401` on failure. On success: remove any session the request came with, create a new id and a new CSRF token, set cookie `sid` (`HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Strict`, `Path=/`), respond `200 {"user": "ada", "csrfToken": "..."}` |
| `GET /notes` | `401` without a session; otherwise `200` with a JSON array of **this user's** note texts, e.g. `["buy milk"]` |
| `POST /notes` `{text}` | `401` / `403` (bad or missing `X-CSRF-Token`) / `400` blank text / `201` |
| `POST /logout` | if there is a session, the CSRF token is required (`403`); delete the session, expire the cookie, `204` |
| `POST /logout-everywhere` | `401` / `403`; delete **every** session of the user, `204` |

template: {{CODE}}
static class DojoTests
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
var c = NewClient(http);
string? sid = null, csrf = null;
await Dojo.TryAsync("Login could be checked", async () =>
DojoWeb.Status("a wrong password gets 401", 401, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/login", null, new { username = "ada", password = "x" }));
DojoWeb.Status("an unknown user gets 401", 401, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/login", null, new { username = "nobody", password = "x" }));
var r = await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/login", "PLANTED", new { username = "ada", password = "correct horse" });
DojoWeb.Status("POST /login as ada gets 200", 200, r);
var header = SetCookie(r, "sid");
Dojo.Check("the cookie is HttpOnly and Secure", HasAttr(header, "httponly") && HasAttr(header, "secure"), header ?? "no sid cookie");
Dojo.Eq("the cookie is SameSite=Strict", "strict", Attr(header, "samesite")?.ToLowerInvariant());
Dojo.Check("the cookie has no Domain", !HasAttr(header, "domain"), header ?? "");
sid = ValueOf(header);
Dojo.Check("the session id is new, at least 32 characters", sid is not null && sid != "PLANTED" && sid.Length >= 32, sid ?? "none");
csrf = DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(r), "csrfToken");
Dojo.Check("the body carries a csrfToken", !string.IsNullOrEmpty(csrf), "no csrfToken");
Dojo.Eq("GET /me says ada", "ada", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(await Send(c, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", sid)), "user"));
await Dojo.TryAsync("Notes could be checked", async () =>
DojoWeb.Status("GET /notes without a session gets 401", 401, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Get, "/notes", null));
DojoWeb.Status("POST /notes without a CSRF token gets 403", 403, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/notes", sid, new { text = "forged" }));
DojoWeb.Status("POST /notes with a blank text gets 400", 400, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/notes", sid, new { text = " " }, csrf));
DojoWeb.Status("POST /notes with the token gets 201", 201, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/notes", sid, new { text = "buy milk" }, csrf));
var list = await DojoWeb.Json(await Send(c, HttpMethod.Get, "/notes", sid));
Dojo.Eq("GET /notes lists only the real note", "buy milk", list.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array ? string.Join("|", list.EnumerateArray().Select(e => e.ToString())) : "(not an array)");
var g = await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/login", null, new { username = "grace", password = "hopper-1906" });
var gsid = ValueOf(SetCookie(g, "sid"));
var glist = await DojoWeb.Json(await Send(c, HttpMethod.Get, "/notes", gsid));
Dojo.Eq("grace sees none of ada's notes", 0, glist.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array ? glist.GetArrayLength() : -1);
DojoWeb.Status("ada's CSRF token is refused in grace's session", 403, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/notes", gsid, new { text = "x" }, csrf));
await Dojo.TryAsync("Logout could be checked", async () =>
var second = await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/login", null, new { username = "ada", password = "correct horse" });
var sid2 = ValueOf(SetCookie(second, "sid"));
var csrf2 = DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(second), "csrfToken");
DojoWeb.Status("POST /logout without the CSRF token gets 403 (no forced logouts)", 403, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/logout", sid, null));
DojoWeb.Status("POST /logout with the token gets 204", 204, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/logout", sid, null, csrf));
DojoWeb.Status("the logged-out id gets 401", 401, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", sid));
DojoWeb.Status("ada's other session still works", 200, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", sid2));
var third = await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/login", null, new { username = "ada", password = "correct horse" });
var sid3 = ValueOf(SetCookie(third, "sid"));
DojoWeb.Status("POST /logout-everywhere gets 204", 204, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/logout-everywhere", sid2, null, csrf2));
DojoWeb.Status("then every ada session gets 401", 401, await Send(c, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", sid3));
static HttpClient NewClient(HttpClient http) =>
new(new HttpClientHandler { UseCookies = false, AllowAutoRedirect = false }) { BaseAddress = http.BaseAddress };
static string? SetCookie(HttpResponseMessage r, string name) =>
r.Headers.TryGetValues("Set-Cookie", out var values) ? values.FirstOrDefault(c => c.StartsWith(name + "=")) : null;
static string? ValueOf(string? header) =>
header is null ? null : header.Split(';')[0].Split('=', 2)[1];
static bool HasAttr(string? header, string attr) =>
header is not null && header.Split(';').Skip(1).Select(p => p.Trim())
.Any(p => p.Equals(attr, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || p.StartsWith(attr + "=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
static string? Attr(string? header, string attr) =>
header?.Split(';').Skip(1).Select(p => p.Trim())
.FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith(attr + "=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))?.Split('=', 2)[1];
static Task<HttpResponseMessage> Send(HttpClient c, HttpMethod method, string url, string? sid, object? body = null, string? csrf = null)
var msg = new HttpRequestMessage(method, url);
if (sid is not null) msg.Headers.Add("Cookie", "sid=" + sid);
if (csrf is not null) msg.Headers.Add("X-CSRF-Token", csrf);
if (body is not null) msg.Content = JsonContent.Create(body);
return c.SendAsync(msg);
static async Task<string?> Login(HttpClient c, string user, string password, string? oldSid = null)
var r = await Send(c, HttpMethod.Post, "/login", oldSid, new { username = user, password });
return ValueOf(SetCookie(r, "sid"));
